Define a Structured Output Schema for LLM Coding

Source: R/schema.R
coding_schema.Rd

Creates a strict schema describing the JSON object returned by an LLM rater. Schemas drive JSON Schema generation (for OpenAI structured outputs or Ollama JSON schema constraints) as well as strict response validation and retry logic in code_texts().

Usage

coding_schema(..., .fields = NULL, name = "llm_coding_output", strict = TRUE)

Arguments

...

Named field specifications created with schema_field() or shorthand type strings ("numeric", "integer", "logical", "character").

.fields

Optional named list of field specifications (merged with ...).

name

Character name for the schema (used by JSON Schema APIs).

strict

Logical; if TRUE (default), unexpected extra keys in the parsed JSON payload trigger validation failure.

Value

An object of class "llm_coding_schema".

Examples

s <- coding_schema(
  score = schema_field("numeric", min = 1, max = 7),
  label = schema_field("factor", levels = c("negative", "neutral", "positive")),
  rationale = schema_field("character", required = FALSE)
)
s
#> 
#> ── LLM Coding Schema: llm_coding_output 
#> Strict: TRUE | Fields: 3 | Hash: 8434e3e3984f
#> • score: "numeric" [1, 7]
#> • label: "factor" {negative, neutral, positive}
#> • rationale: "character" optional
